notes: REF-BM-02: capture.js (meta()) pulls title/description/og:image but never fetches a favicon — no icon field anywhere in store/client. REF-BM-04: no 'note' field exists on the bookmark record at all, so notes can't be edited (url/title/description/tags are editable). REF-BM-06: create() detects the duplicate url and returns the existing item, but the client only flashes/highlights the card (flashId) — it does not open the edit form, so it surfaces rather than 'guides to edit'. REF-BM-07: list cards show title/description/tags/thumbnail but no favicon icon. REF-BM-08: clicking a card opens an in-app reader/viewer modal (openViewer) rather than navigating to the url directly; a 'Visit the original page' link inside requires a second click. REF-BM-10: the tag input (e-tag) only supports Enter/comma to add a chip — no datalist/suggestion list of existing labels is offered. REF-BM-12: full-text search covers title/summary/labels/url/body but there is no note field to search since notes don't exist. REF-BM-14: search.js's parseQuery has no handling for a leading '#' — tag search only works by clicking a label pill, not by typing #tag in the query. REF-BM-15: AND (default)/OR ('or')/NOT ('not'/'without'/'except'/'-') are implemented in parseQuery, but there is no parenthesized-group support (parens are treated as literal characters in tokens). REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select checkboxes or bulk-action UI/endpoints exist anywhere in app.js or index.js — only per-item actions. REF-BM-22: list() always sorts by savedAt descending; no sort-key option is exposed via API or UI. REF-BM-23: no note field/markdown rendering exists. REF-BM-24: 'saved copy' is Readability-extracted plain text (copyText), not a stored local HTML single-file snapshot, and capture() explicitly rejects non-HTML content-types so there is no PDF-download branch. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive/Wayback integration in capture.js or elsewhere. REF-BM-29: no bundle entity (saved search+tag filter) exists in store.js. REF-BM-31: /api/export (exportAll) returns the app's own JSON format, not Netscape HTML. REF-BM-32: no settings entity/UI for default sort, displayed items, or font size.
